annotations.title: Regex ReDoS Vulnerability Scanner & Pattern Explainer API

description: Regex ReDoS Vulnerability Scanner & Pattern Explainer API: Audit regular expressions for O(2^n) ReDoS backtracking, explain patterns, and test matches. (Endpoint: POST /v1/regex-safety)

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern string (without surrounding /.../ slashes, or in /pattern/flags literal format).

test_strings.description: Optional sample strings (max 512 chars each) to test against the pattern when safe to execute.
